THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / OCTOBER 2026
RUNWAY
086
STUDY 115
Blue Runway Coat & Striped Socks
Rights check / Repeats Study 83.
Source: 24984.jpg
Structured, cool, refined
WORKING NOTES
- The powder blue coat and striped socks are the color
anchors.
- Keep only one of sections 82 or 115 if you do not need
both.
Try this: Emphasize the powder blue coat and striped
socks.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
tousled brown hair walks a runway in an
oversized powder blue wool coat with
toggle fastenings and large patch
pockets. Beneath it, a dark brown
pleated mini skirt with a textured knit
overlay, sheer brown tights, and pale
blue ribbed socks. Black pointed loafers
complete the look. Her expression is
calm and direct. A pale stone runway
with warm wooden walls. This is a
duplicate of section 82.
